variants.name: .338 Norma
variants.info: Loads your Arctic Warfare with .338 Norma Magnum. This cartridge was developed to surpass the performance of .338 Lapua Magnum. Having a shorter cartridge length. While it does not travel as fast and torso kill as far, it retains your one shot limb range while improving your firing speed!

variants.name: .308 Win
variants.info: Changes the ammunition fired from your AWM into .308 Winchester effectively changing it into the AWP! A much lighter but still deadly ammo type still capable of an one shot limb kill but much shorter. Improves handling, recoil, firing speed and doubles your ammo capacity! Perfect to counter terrorism!

variants.name: Tracerless
variants.info:
Ammo that doesn't have the components that create weapon tracers.

Greater overall accuracy for less range performance and bullet penetration.
